scripts.build: echo '🚀 Starting build at $(date)' && time next build && echo '✅ Build completed at $(date)'
scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p public && (cp cache/verses.json.gz public/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp full_dictionary_enriched.json word_frequency_list.json form_to_root_map.json form_occurrence_index.json yousafzai_word_frequency_list.json public/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp inflections_cache.json public/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.upload:audio: node scripts/upload_audio.js "../Pashto new testament with audio"
scripts.warm-caches: curl -X GET "https://pashto-bible-search.vercel.app/api/search?action=warm" && echo "✅ Caches warmed successfully"
scripts.preload-searches: curl -X GET "https://pashto-bible-search.vercel.app/api/search?action=preload" && echo "✅ Common searches preloaded"
scripts.clear-caches: curl -X GET "https://pashto-bible-search.vercel.app/api/search?action=clear" && echo "✅ All caches cleared"
scripts.postdeploy: npm run warm-caches && npm run preload-searches
